title: IntegrationEventEnvelope
description: Envelope shared by every cross-context integration event (curriculum §1.8). Published through the Outbox, delivered at least once; consumers dedup on the key documented in each event schema.

eventId.description: Unique per event; also the Outbox row id.

version.description: Same number as the .vN suffix in type.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened in the domain (not when it was published).

correlationId.description: Same for the whole business flow (one afternoon at CP-A12-2).

causationId.description: eventId (or command id) of the message that directly caused this one.
